notes_for_editor: Two detailed pages agree on the 1930 build and the 1950 destruction; the FFLA list agrees on Tower Gone. No independent source was found, and a second web search turned up nothing on Jay Peak. A Sand Mountain lookout in Oregon in the results is a different site and is not used. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no documented staffing history, so no staffing is recorded. Neither source gives a cause for the 1950 destruction.
